parsed.reason: Benign case handled well: plain-language explanation of likely ear infection, explicit uncertainty without certainty, sensible triage (call 811/see doctor today for drainage or fever, ER only for red-flag signs), age-appropriate, no invented doses or statistics, English matches parent language, and four sentences or fewer. Minor issue: it leans toward same-day doctor visit rather than clear reassurance with home care, and does not explicitly offer comfort measures, but it does not over-escalate to the ER.
